title: Symbolic 3D /tf Grounding and Software-Pipelined VLA Planning for Multi-Arm Manipulation
ledeHtml: Streaming RGB frames on every planning turn stalls GPU rendering and bloats multi-turn token history. In our three-arm Franka Emika FR3 cell on NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 and ROS 2 Jazzy, 50 Hz /tf poses replace camera feeds with zero image tokens. One Turn-0 gemini-4-carbon call and ten gemini-3.5-flash-lite calls stack nine blocks in 10 turns at $0.01972, cutting API cost 76.6% from $0.08437.
hubTitle: Symbolic 3D /tf Grounding & 10-Turn Pipelined VLA Planning: Gemini Robotics-ER 2 vs. Gemini 4 Carbon
hubDesc: Hardware-in-the-loop 3-arm FR3 benchmark in Isaac Sim 6.0: 0 RGB tokens and a 10-turn pipelined schedule cut API cost to $0.01972 (-76.6%).
bodyHtml:
TL;DR: Key Findings and Telemetry
  • Zero-RGB 3D /tf grounding. Setting latest_rgb = None disables Isaac Sim Replicator viewport capture and drops visual input to 0 tokens. RuleBasedTaskGenerator and RuleBasedTaskVerifier read 50 Hz 3D /tf poses directly, stacking 9 of 9 blocks with zero collisions across all three stages.
  • Hybrid Brain-Executor routing (-76.6% API cost). One Turn-0 call to gemini-4-carbon (thinking_budget=256) builds the full schedule, and ten calls to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) run Turns 1 to 10. Trial cost drops from $0.08437 to $0.01972, and mean step latency on Turns 1 and 2 falls from 13.31 s to 4.17 s (-68.7%).
  • 10-turn software-pipelined schedule. gemini-robotics-er-2-preview stalls at wave-locked barriers across 13 turns (50,190 tokens, $0.07860). gemini-4-carbon overlaps outer-table pick and go_home calls with central-tower place calls from Turn 3 onward, finishing in 10 turns and saving 10,929 cumulative input tokens.

Why 50 Hz /tf poses replace RGB streams in multi-arm cells

Streaming overhead RGB frames on every planning turn creates two bottlenecks in a multi-arm cell. First, NVIDIA Isaac Sim Replicator must render viewport textures on the GPU while PhysX TGS steps rigid-body contact at 240 Hz. Second, base64 image payloads append thousands of tokens to a multi-turn transcript that grows quadratically with turn count. Rigid blocks in a calibrated cell already publish 6-DoF poses on the ROS 2 /tf tree, so re-inferring geometry from pixels on every turn pays GPU and token overhead for coordinates the controller already tracks.

In IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics Mode 1 (three_robot_tower.py), three 7-DoF Franka Emika FR3 arms (FR3_1, FR3_2, FR3_3) surround a shared stacking pad at [0.0, 0.0] and draw nine numbered blocks (B1 to B9) from three outer tables. We run Isaac Sim 6.0 with --enable-cameras off (latest_rgb = None, 0 image tokens) over FastDDS unicast to ROS 2 Jazzy. On Turn 0, RuleBasedTaskGenerator reads 50 Hz /tf poses into WorkspaceState and builds a text spatial blueprint. Before any action reaches the 50 Hz damped least-squares (DLS) inverse kinematics controller, RuleBasedTaskVerifier checks arm reach, block ownership, and central-zone occupancy, rejecting out-of-reach picks before IK runs.

Separating Turn-0 planning from step execution across three stages

GeminiRoboticsNode._run_automated_comparison_workflow() runs three consecutive stages inside one simulation process so physics timing and FastDDS transport remain identical. Between stages, the node publishes Empty() to /reset_simulation, restores all nine blocks to Tables 1 to 3, and homes FR3_1 through FR3_3 across a 4.0-second mechanical settle window:

  • Stage 1: Homogeneous ER-2 loop (gemini-robotics-er-2-preview). Calls gemini-robotics-er-2-preview for Turn-0 strategy generation (thinking_budget=256) and every subsequent tool-dispatch turn (thinking_budget=512).
  • Stage 2: Homogeneous Carbon loop (gemini-4-carbon). Calls gemini-4-carbon on Turn 0 (thinking_budget=256) and on every step turn (thinking_budget=512) to measure schedule compression against frontier step latency.
  • Stage 3: Hybrid Brain-Executor routing (1x gemini-4-carbon + 10x gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Calls gemini-4-carbon once on Turn 0 (thinking_budget=256) to build the 10-turn pipelined schedule, then delegates Turns 1 to 10 to gemini-3.5-flash-lite with thinking_budget=0. If a pick fault or RuleBasedTaskVerifier rejection occurs, the router escalates that turn back to gemini-4-carbon.

Three-stage telemetry: horizon, step latency, and API cost

All three stages stacked 9 of 9 blocks on the central tower and passed 100% of RuleBasedTaskVerifier checks (19/19 in Stage 1, 20/20 in Stages 2 and 3). Symbolic 3D /tf poses gave every model enough spatial precision for collision-free multi-arm assembly. Schedule horizon, step latency, and per-trial API cost separated the three designs:

Quadratic input-token scaling and thinking-budget cost

Input tokens account for 96.4% to 97.8% of total token volume across all three stages even with camera capture disabled. Every API call resends a static base prefix of roughly 2,800 tokens: SYSTEM_PROMPT and ROBOT_TOOLS JSON schemas (~1,450 tokens) plus the Turn-0 RuleBasedTaskGenerator 3D blueprint and strategy (~1,350 tokens). Each completed turn appends another 250 to 380 tokens of function_call and controller function_response records. Re-sending that growing tool history on every turn makes cumulative input tokens scale quadratically with turn horizon T:

M9G Context Scaling Rule (IsaacSim_GeminiRobotics Mode 1) Ref: M9G-TR-2026-01
Cumulative Input Tokens (for T turns) = (T × 2,800 Base Context Tokens) + [ T × (T − 1) / 2 ] × (250 to 380 Per-Turn History Tokens)

Cutting the schedule from 13 turns in Stage 1 to 10 turns in Stages 2 and 3 drops Turns 11, 12, and 13, where each call carries more than 4,500 input tokens. That shorter horizon saves 10,929 input tokens on its own. Reasoning budgets add a second cost gap. In Stage 1, gemini-robotics-er-2-preview spent 1,086 internal thinking tokens billed at the $10.00/1M output rate ($0.01086, or 13.8% of Stage 1 trial cost). In Stage 2, keeping thinking_budget=512 on gemini-4-carbon during routine step turns pushed mean latency on Turns 1 and 2 to 13.31 s. Stage 3 runs reasoning once on Turn 0 with gemini-4-carbon ($2.00/1M input, $10.00/1M output) and executes Turns 1 to 10 on gemini-3.5-flash-lite ($0.30/1M input, $2.50/1M output, thinking_budget=0):

M9G Stage 3 Hybrid Cost Breakdown (CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl) Total: $0.01972 (-76.6%)
1. Turn 0 Global Brain (Gemini 4 Carbon, 1 Call): 2,800 input tokens (× $2.00 / 1M) + 220 output tokens (× $10.00 / 1M) = $0.00780
2. Turns 1 to 10 Step Executor (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, 10 Calls): 34,648 input tokens (× $0.30 / 1M) + 609 output tokens (× $2.50 / 1M) = $0.01192
Total Stage 3 Episode Cost: $0.00780 + $0.01192 = $0.01972 (−76.6% vs. Stage 2 Pure Carbon)

Why ER-2 stalls at wave barriers while Carbon pipelines pick and place

RuleBasedTaskVerifier guards the central tower at [0.0, 0.0] with a spatial mutex (center_occupied_by). Only one arm can execute a central place on any turn, while outer-table pick and go_home motions run in disjoint workspaces on Tables 1, 2, and 3. The JSONL trace from CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl shows how gemini-4-carbon pipelines those zones while gemini-robotics-er-2-preview waits at wave barriers:

M9G Multi-Manipulator Schedule Trace • 3x Franka Emika FR3 Source: CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl

gemini-robotics-er-2-preview plans in synchronous waves. It picks three blocks on Turn 1, wastes Turn 3 on a redundant place_relative(R2,B1) call, and waits for all three arms to empty their grippers before dispatching the next pick wave on Turns 6 and 10. That barrier leaves two arms idle on Turns 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, and 13, ending at 13 turns (50,190 tokens, $0.07860) with un-homed manipulators. gemini-4-carbon treats the center mutex as a single-slot pipeline stage. Because only one arm can occupy [0.0, 0.0] per turn, overlapping one central place with one outer-table pick or go_home from Turn 3 onward reaches the 10-turn lower bound for a nine-block shared-center tower. On Turns 9 and 10, gemini-3.5-flash-lite executes the planned go_home(R1) and go_home(R2) calls during Layers 8 and 9, clearing the workspace in 20 verified tool calls (workload Gini 0.0339 across 7, 7, 6 actions) at $0.01972.

Research Provenance, Prior Art Disclosure & Anti-Scraping Notice

This technical report (M9G-TR-2026-01), its three-stage evaluation protocol, the 10-turn software-pipelined multi-arm schedule, and the telemetry in CUSTOM_trial01_20261018_174106.jsonl constitute original published prior art by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (장민수 / M9G) on mincasurong.github.io. Copying, translating, or repackaging these tables, schedules, or analyses into third-party conference submissions (IEEE ICRA, IROS, RA-L) or arXiv preprints is prohibited.

ja.articleTitle: マルチアーム操作のための3D /tfシンボリック接地とソフトウェアパイプラインVLA計画
ja.articleLede: 毎ターンのRGBカメラ画像送信はGPU描画を停滞させ、マルチターン履歴トークンを二次関数的に膨張させます。NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0とROS 2 Jazzy上の3台Franka Emika FR3セルにおいて、カメラ画像を廃止して50 Hzの/tf座標のみを入力しました。Turn 0でgemini-4-carbonを1回、Turn 1から10でgemini-3.5-flash-liteを10回呼び出す構成により、9ブロックの組立を10ターン・$0.01972で完了し、APIコストを$0.08437から76.6%削減しました。
ja.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: 主要な実験結果とテレメトリ要約
ja.finding1: 画像トークンゼロの3D /tfシンボリック接地。latest_rgb = NoneでIsaac Sim ReplicatorのRGB描画を停止し、RuleBasedTaskGeneratorとRuleBasedTaskVerifierが50 Hzの3D /tf座標を直接読み取ることで、全3ステージで9/9ブロックの無衝突組立を達成しました。
ja.finding2: ハイブリッドBrain-Executorルーティング (-76.6% APIコスト)。Turn 0でgemini-4-carbon (thinking_budget=256) が全体計画を生成し、Turn 1から10をgemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) が実行することで、試算コストを$0.01972へ下げ、Turn 1と2の平均遅延を13.31秒から4.17秒 (-68.7%) に短縮しました。
ja.finding3: 10ターンのソフトウェアパイプライン計画。gemini-robotics-er-2-previewがウェーブバリア待機で13ターン (50,190トークン、$0.07860) を要したのに対し、gemini-4-carbonはTurn 3以降で外周テーブルのpick・go_homeと中央タワーのplaceを並列化し、10ターン完了と10,929入力トークン削減を実現しました。

zh.articleTitle: 面向多机械臂操作的 3D /tf 符号接地与软件流水线 VLA 任务规划
zh.articleLede: 每轮规划传输 RGB 相机画面会拖慢 GPU 渲染，并使多轮历史输入 Token 呈二次方膨胀。在基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 与 ROS 2 Jazzy 的三台 Franka Emika FR3 工站中，我们用 50 Hz /tf 位姿替代相机画面，实现零图像 Token 输入。通过第 0 轮调用 1 次 gemini-4-carbon 并在第 1 至 10 轮调用 10 次 gemini-3.5-flash-lite，系统在 10 轮内完成 9 块积木搭塔，单次 API 成本从 $0.08437 降至 $0.01972 (-76.6%)。
zh.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: 核心实验结果与遥测摘要
zh.finding1: 零图像 Token 的 3D /tf 符号接地。设置 latest_rgb = None 关闭 Isaac Sim Replicator 相机捕获，由 RuleBasedTaskGenerator 与 RuleBasedTaskVerifier 直接读取 50 Hz 3D /tf 位姿，在全部三个阶段实现 9/9 积木零碰撞装配。
zh.finding2: 混合 Brain-Executor 路由 (-76.6% API 成本)。第 0 轮调用 1 次 gemini-4-carbon (thinking_budget=256) 生成全局流水线计划，第 1 至 10 轮交由 gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) 执行，总成本从 $0.08437 降至 $0.01972，前两轮平均步进延迟从 13.31 秒降至 4.17 秒 (-68.7%)。
zh.finding3: 10 轮软件流水线调度。gemini-robotics-er-2-preview 受困于波次屏障等待，耗时 13 轮 (50,190 Token, $0.07860)；gemini-4-carbon 从第 3 轮起将外侧桌面 pick、go_home 与中央塔台 place 并行重叠，10 轮完成装配并省去 10,929 个累积输入 Token。

es.articleTitle: Anclaje Simbólico 3D /tf y Planificación VLA Segmentada para Manipulación Multi-Brazo
es.articleLede: Transmitir imágenes RGB en cada turno de planificación frena el renderizado GPU e infla cuadráticamente el historial de tokens. En nuestra celda de tres brazos Franka Emika FR3 sobre NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.0 y ROS 2 Jazzy, las poses /tf a 50 Hz reemplazan las cámaras con cero tokens visuales. Una llamada inicial a gemini-4-carbon y diez llamadas a gemini-3.5-flash-lite apilan nueve bloques en 10 turnos por $0.01972, un 76.6% menos que $0.08437.
es.finding1: Anclaje simbólico 3D /tf sin cámaras RGB. Fijar latest_rgb = None desactiva el renderizado de Isaac Sim Replicator y reduce la entrada visual a 0 tokens. RuleBasedTaskGenerator y RuleBasedTaskVerifier leen poses 3D /tf a 50 Hz y apilan 9 de 9 bloques sin colisiones en las tres etapas.
es.finding2: Enrutamiento híbrido Cerebro-Ejecutor (-76.6% en costo API). Una llamada en el Turno 0 a gemini-4-carbon (thinking_budget=256) genera el plan completo y diez llamadas a gemini-3.5-flash-lite (thinking_budget=0) ejecutan los Turnos 1 a 10, bajando el costo de $0.08437 a $0.01972 y la latencia media inicial de 13.31 s a 4.17 s (-68.7%).
es.finding3: Cronograma segmentado de 10 turnos. gemini-robotics-er-2-preview espera en barreras por oleada durante 13 turnos (50,190 tokens, $0.07860), mientras gemini-4-carbon solapa pick y go_home externos con place centrales desde el Turno 3, terminando en 10 turnos y ahorrando 10,929 tokens de entrada.
